addedSugarEstimates.basis: Escondido publishes no added sugar for it (null, breakfast and lunch). Its nutrition facts (111.1 kcal, 18.0 g sugars, 8.0 g protein, 135.0 mg sodium) match Del Mar Union's Fat Free Chocolate Milk (110, 18, 8, 135), for which Del Mar publishes 7 g added sugar, and the Hollandia Dairy spec sheet Del Mar posts for it (110 kcal, 18 g sugars, 8 g protein, 135 mg sodium per 8 fl oz; QC date 2017-10-17, no Added Sugars line): https://www.dmusd.org/documents/Parents--Community/Student-Nutrition-Program/Additional-Links/Fat%20Free%20Chocolate%20Milk.pdf. San Diego Unified publishes 7 g for its 1% chocolate milk (120 kcal, 18 g sugars). Bubba chose this estimate 2026-10-15, until Escondido publishes its own.

Escondido publishes 0 g added sugar (its menu panel shows 0 g too, checked 2026-10-15). On every value all three districts publish, it matches San Diego Unified's Concha (Mexican Sweet Bread, 2.25 oz) and Del Mar Union's Pan Dulce Variety (200 kcal, 1.5 g saturated fat, 90 mg sodium, 2 g fiber, 8 g total sugars, 5 g protein), and both publish 7 g added sugar. No maker's label found. Added 2026-10-15.
